component.name: Roblox Manager
component.summary: Launch several Roblox accounts into the same server

description.p: Signs in several Roblox accounts, launches them together into one server behind a leader, and plays input macros into them.

ul.li: Accounts sign in with Roblox Quick Login; sessions stay in the keyring
A leader launches first and its auto-join accounts follow into its server
Groups of accounts, each with a game of its own
Launch into a favourite game, Roblox's games browser, or a friend's server
Macros play keys and clicks into a client while you use other windows
Low-power clients for accounts along for the ride

description.p: Roblox's rules treat simultaneous clients as a policy violation, and community reports tie them to anti-cheat flags. The second client only ever starts on an explicit click.
A new window on libadwaita, in the system's light or dark style.

ul.li: Accounts as native rows, with Roblox avatars, live status and a menu
Account and group settings in dialogs of their own
Search accounts by name, Roblox user or note
The whole activity log, and desktop notifications for long launches
Keyboard shortcuts, and a dialog listing them
Removing or deleting anything asks first
